latin: Cum dicit Plato in Timao in medio mundi positam animam, quicquid dicant caeteri Platonici, ego per medium lunam intelligo.
translation: When Plato says in the Timaeus that the soul is placed in the middle of the world, I—whatever the other Platonists may say—understand the moon by 'the middle.'
